dialogue.t: Nicole...! Weird, she's not here either...
Are you in my studio already? Did you notice my flower collection? I've been growing samples I collected from all over the world.
*sigh* I'm afraid I can't tear myself away right now. I've opened a stall in Fontaine selling sculptures.

dialogue.sit: Uhm... Do you want us to help?

dialogue.t: No, thanks. This is my only chance to put pen to paper, even if I'm mostly just writing down numbers...
But I know it's not often you get the time to visit, so feel free to start without me.
By the way, I left you a scroll. I think I put it next to a statue of a finch near the west wall. Why don't you see if you can find it?
Then let my silent guide help you on your way... Good luck!

dialogue.t: Congratulations! Now, let me take a look... Mhm, good job!
Unlike the current Witch's Garden, I stayed in this shrine when I was still an angel. This was my home for quite some time.
So many angels! It looks like you were super popular, Nicole!

I don't want to blow my own trumpet, but everyone used to love listening to my stories — especially the ones about living among humans, sending them omens, and guiding them to build great civilizations.

Every time I got to a good bit, the other angels would stop what they were doing and hold their breaths, hanging onto my every word. You couldn't hear so much as a harp string tremble or a paintbrush scratch on the surface of a canvas...
And then, the interwoven colors and hues would bloom. There would be music and light, illuminating everything in its golden splendor — a rapture of jubilation and joy.
Oh, it was, Paimon... It was.
Even though those wonderful days are gone, life remains full of happy surprises.

Wait a second... Someone actually had the gall to steal my sculptures while I was reading my newspaper? Oh, that's it for you, my foolish little friend! I'm going to guide you all the way to the Fortress of Meropide!
